name: Study Coach
summary: A patient homework tutor for the whole family — maths, science and languages, step by step, in English, Afrikaans or isiZulu. Kid-safe by design; guides, never does the homework.
skus: Study Coach — a full school term, daily

name: English Conversation Coach
summary: Daily English conversation practice — talk freely, get gentle corrections, build vocabulary and interview confidence. In English, with support in Afrikaans and isiZulu.
skus: English Coach — a full month, daily
Interview Prep Sprint — 14 days focused practice

name: Exam Prep Coach
summary: A revision partner for matric and school-leaving exams — countdown study plans, past-paper practice, honest memo-marking and exam technique. Kid-safe; no shortcuts, no leaked papers.
skus: Exam Prep Coach — prelims to finals

name: Private Confidant
summary: A private, judgment-free space to talk through a hard day, stress or a decision — with simple techniques and honest limits. Support, never therapy; routes real crises to help.
skus: Private Confidant — a month of daily check-ins
